procedural.content: Hypothesis for release crash: Object lifetime issue. Standard library objects allocated during run() might outlive custom heap destruction in shutdown(). When operator delete is called after g_custom_heap is nullptr, it tries std::free() on memory from custom heap buffer, causing crash. Optimizer behavior differs between DEBUG (-O0) and RELEASE (-O2) affecting object lifetimes.
